newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on institutional buying.

text.p: The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index rose 6.97 points or 0.62 percent at 1,115.99 on a turnover of 54.2 million taka on Wedndesday. Of 127 traded issues 70 gained and 56 lost and one unchanged.
"Institutional support encouraged retail buying in the market," said one broker. Brokers said scrips with a sound financial base were attracting investors.
Aftab Automobiles gained 11 taka to 341, Monno Fabrics rose 1.86 to 138.15 and Orion Infusion lost 2.4 to 138.45.
